# Neural Project Institute

> Neural Project Institute (neuralprojectinstitute.com) is an independent project management education site. It publishes free, in-depth guides on project management, Agile, Scrum and Kanban; free Excel, Google Sheets and PDF templates; independent reviews and comparisons of project management software; and the PMAI (Project Management Artificial Intelligence) certification. Contact: support@neuralprojectinstitute.com.

Guides are written in British English, cite primary sources (PMI, the Scrum Guide 2020, the Kanban Guide, vendor documentation) and label worked examples as illustrative. Most pages are also available in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Russian and Chinese under /de/, /es/, /fr/, /it/, /ja/, /ru/ and /zh/. The full text of every English page is in [llms-full.txt](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/llms-full.txt).


## Home

- [PMAI: Project Management Artificial Intelligence Certification](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/): Earn the PMAI (Project Management Artificial Intelligence) certification from the Neural Project Institute: six assessed online courses with verifiable certificates.

- [What Is Scrum? How the Scrum Framework Works, With Examples](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/scrum/what-is-scrum/): What is Scrum? A clear guide to the Scrum framework: team, events, artifacts, pillars and values, a worked Sprint example, and when to use Scrum.

## Kanban guides

- [The Kanban Guide](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/): A complete, free Kanban guide: principles, boards, cards, WIP limits, flow metrics, comparisons with Scrum, and Lean foundations.
- [Blocker Clustering: How to Find and Fix Recurring Delays](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/blocker-clustering/): Blocker clustering groups blocked Kanban work by cause and cost in blocked days. Learn the steps, a worked example, the priority matrix and common fixes.
- [Continuous Delivery: Pipeline, Principles and Kanban Flow](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/continuous-delivery/): Continuous delivery keeps software always releasable. Learn how it differs from CI and continuous deployment, the pipeline, DORA metrics and Kanban flow.
- [Cumulative Flow Diagram: How to Read and Use a CFD](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/cumulative-flow-diagram/): A cumulative flow diagram (CFD) shows work in each stage over time. Learn to read bands, spot bottlenecks, estimate cycle time and build one step by step.
- [Cycle Time vs Lead Time: Differences, Formulas, Examples](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/cycle-time-vs-lead-time/): Cycle time vs lead time explained: where each starts and stops, how to calculate both, worked Kanban examples, Little's Law and which one to report.
- [Cycle Time in Kanban: Formula, Examples and How to Reduce It](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/cycle-time/): Cycle time in Kanban is how long an item takes from start to finish. Learn the formula, percentiles, scatterplots and SLEs, with worked examples.
- [What Is DevOps? Culture, Practices and Metrics](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/devops/): DevOps explained: its origins, the CALMS model, the Three Ways, key practices, DORA metrics, and how DevOps connects to Lean, Agile and Kanban.
- [Flow Efficiency: Formula, Examples and How to Improve It](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/flow-efficiency/): Flow efficiency explained: the formula, worked examples, how to measure active and wait time on a Kanban board, what a good figure is and how to improve it.
- [Just-in-Time (JIT): How It Works, Examples, Pros and Cons](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/just-in-time-jit/): Just-in-Time (JIT) explained: how pull, takt time and kanban work, a worked cost example, pros and cons, JIT vs just-in-case and JIT in projects.
- [Kanban Board: What It Is, Examples and How to Build One](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/kanban-boards/): What is a Kanban board? Learn its parts, see examples for software, marketing and IT, and build your own step by step with WIP limits and policies.
- [Kanban Cards: What to Put on Them and Why](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/kanban-cards/): What a Kanban card is, the information each card should show, how to size work items, blocker markers, and examples of well-designed cards.
- [Kanban Meetings and Cadences: Which Ones You Need](https://neuralprojectinstitute.com/project-management/kanban/kanban-ceremonies/): The Kanban cadences explained: daily Kanban meeting, replenishment, delivery planning, service delivery review, operations, risk and strategy reviews.
